title: Water disruption
label: WATER
deck: Read the exact notice before treating or using tap water.
tldr: After a water outage, damaged pipes or suspected contamination, use sealed bottled or previously stored safe water until you establish the risk. Boil-water, do-not-drink and do-not-use notices mean different things. Boiling kills germs but does not remove fuel, chemicals or radioactive contamination. If notices are unavailable, do not treat clear water or restored pressure as proof of safety.
steps: Find the utility or health department notice for your address, its start time, reason, and permitted uses. Save a screenshot in case service fails.

A boil-water notice generally addresses microbes; follow the authority's boil directions. If the notice says do not drink or do not use, follow those stricter limits and the specified alternative-water instructions.
Set aside approved water for drinking, infant formula, medications, tooth brushing, food preparation, and pets, as the notice directs.
Do not assume that water is safe because it looks clear or service has returned. Follow flushing or filter replacement instructions after an official all-clear.
next: Store water and a printed copy of your utility's alert channel. Know whether anyone in the household needs extra water or cannot use a typical treatment method.
watch: Do not boil water suspected of chemical or fuel contamination. Boiling can concentrate some contaminants; use the alternative source named in the notice.
review_status: source-linked editorial review; not independent expert certification
without_help: If there is no notice after pressure loss, flooding or damaged pipes, use sealed or previously stored safe water while you establish the risk. Do not assume that boiling solves an unknown contamination problem. Label containers and keep drinking water separate from cleaning water.
household: Write down water, food, battery and medication needs for each person. Keep clean and dirty containers separate and preserve essential power before entertainment. Agree on the point at which lack of water, medical support or safe temperature means you must relocate.
pack_now: Keep essential medicines, drinking water, a battery light, shoes, phone power and a written contact card within reach. Adapt the load to the hazard and the people with you; do not delay escape to collect equipment.
